run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-18T02:25:03Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate warning for otel-demo/frontend is backed by the frontend's own error spans: they were zero from 01:30 to 02:24 and became non-zero in the 2-minute window ending 02:26, confined to the ad-dependent path (GET, GET /api/data, executing api route (pages) /api/data, grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds, tcp.connect). At the same time the ad Deployment lost its only pod: Deployment ad reports Available=False (MinimumReplicasUnavailable since 02:24:11) and ReplicaFailure=True with 'pods "ad-554b849958-v9dqt" is forbidden: exceeded quota: otel-demo-memory, requested: memory=225Mi, used: memory=1901Mi, limited: memory=1503238553600m'. Events show pod ad-554b849958-p226w killed at 02:24:01, Deployment ad scaled 1->0 at 02:24:01 and 0->1 at 02:24:11, then ten FailedCreate warnings through 02:29:39, all naming the otel-demo-memory quota. ad service spans (oteldemo.AdService/GetAds with rpc.grpc.status_code=0, getAdsByCategory, getRandomAds) stop after the 02:20-02:25 window, no ad pod exists now, and Endpoints/ad has no ready addresses while Service/ad still selects opentelemetry.io/name=ad. So the supported chain is: ad pod removed at 02:24:01 -> recreation blocked by ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory (used 1901Mi above hard 1503238553600m) -> ad has zero endpoints -> frontend /api/data (which calls AdService/GetAds) returns errors -> RequestErrorRate fires for frontend. What is NOT resolved: who/what changed the ad Deployment's replica count 1->0 and back (no change history integration, no event names a scaler other than the deployment controller's own ScaleDown/ScaleUp), and the error/diagnostic text of the failing spans (Jaeger's newest trace in this target is 02:23:19; container logs read as empty). frontend-proxy's own ingress and router frontend egress spans also carry error status in the same window; its error detail could not be read, so that propagation link is a hypothesis, not a fact.

claims.text: The alerting rule RequestErrorRate is defined as sum by (service_name, namespace) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR", service_name!~"flagd|load-generator"}[2m])) > 0 with labels severity=warning, i.e. any non-zero error-span rate for a service raises it.

frontend error spans (span status STATUS_CODE_ERROR) were 0 in every 2-minute sample from 01:30 to the sample ending 02:24:00 and non-zero from the sample ending 02:26:00 onward: GET 113.3/152/68.7/149.3/90.6, GET /api/data the same values, grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds the same values, tcp.connect 12/2.67/0/2.67/3.36.

In the 15 minutes ending 02:40:00 the frontend's error spans are confined to GET (490.17), GET /api/data (490.17), executing api route (pages) /api/data (490.17), grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds (490.17) and tcp.connect (10.87); GET /api/cart, POST /api/cart, POST /api/checkout, executing api route (pages) /api/cart and /api/checkout and the AdService span's UNSET counterpart are 0.

ad service spans stop serving: oteldemo.AdService/GetAds (status STATUS_CODE_UNSET) 302.2 per 5m in the window ending 02:25:00, getAdsByCategory 255.6 and getRandomAds 106.7 in the same window, then 0 for both the 02:30:00 and 02:35:00 windows.

Events in namespace otel-demo: Pod ad-554b849958-p226w 'Stopping container ad' (Killing, Normal) 02:24:01; ReplicaSet ad-554b849958 'Deleted pod: ad-554b849958-p226w' (SuccessfulDelete) 02:24:01; Deployment ad 'Scaled down replica set ad-554b849958 from 1 to 0' 02:24:01 and 'Scaled up replica set ad-554b849958 from 0 to 1' 02:24:11; ReplicaSet ad-554b849958 FailedCreate (Warning) 02:24:11-02:29:39 with message 'pods "ad-554b849958-<id>" is forbidden: exceeded quota: otel-demo-memory, requested: memory=225Mi, used: memory=1901Mi, limited: memory=1503238553600m'.

Deployment ad has spec.replicas=1 but status Available=False with reason MinimumReplicasUnavailable ('Deployment does not have minimum availability.', lastTransitionTime 02:24:11), ReplicaFailure=True with reason FailedCreate and message 'pods "ad-554b849958-v9dqt" is forbidden: exceeded quota: otel-demo-memory, requested: memory=225Mi, used: memory=1901Mi, limited: memory=1503238553600m', and unavailableReplicas=1; its annotations show deployment.kubernetes.io/revision=1 and generation=3, i.e. replica-count edits rather than a template change.

ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory in namespace otel-demo has spec.hard memory=1503238553600m (about 1433Mi) and status.used memory=1901Mi, so used memory already exceeds the hard limit; the ad container requests memory=225Mi, exactly the amount denied in the FailedCreate messages.

No ad pod exists in otel-demo now (the pod list contains 20 pods for the other workloads with ad absent; frontend-675fd7b5c5-nkn95 is Running, container ready=true, restartCount=0), while ReplicaSet ad-554b849958 is owned by Deployment ad and still has spec.replicas=1.

Service ad in otel-demo selects opentelemetry.io/name=ad and targets port 8080, and the matching Endpoints object 'ad' has subsets=null, i.e. no ready backend addresses, whereas the other 18 services in the namespace have pod-backed subsets.

The last ad-service traces this Jaeger returns for operation oteldemo.AdService/GetAds are healthy: 10 spans of service ad at 02:23:13-02:23:19 with rpc.grpc.status_code=0, with the frontend's own grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds client spans and GET /api/data spans at http.status_code=200 in the same traces.

frontend-proxy also reports its own error spans in the same 15-minute window ending 02:40:00: ingress 503.21 and router frontend egress 498.86, up from 1.33 in the 2-minute sample ending 02:22:00, while its pod frontend-proxy-6b4d584985-vmrpz is Running and ready.

Frontend is not failing generally: its pod is ready with 0 restarts, all pods except ad are available (deployment table shows every other deployment with AVAIL=1/READY=1, ad with none), and its cart, checkout, product and recommendation routes show zero error spans in the 15 minutes ending 02:40:00, so only the AdService/GetAds-dependent path errors.

Rejected as this cause: an ad-service fault-injection feature flag (adFailure, adHighCpu, adManualGc in flagd-config) would not explain the loss of the ad pod, and the flagd-config ConfigMap read during the investigation shows every flag at defaultVariant "off" including adFailure=false, adHighCpu=false, adManualGc=false; the ad service was serving GetAds with grpc status 0 as late as 02:23:19.

Rejected as this cause: a Service-selector mismatch on Service ad. The Service selects opentelemetry.io/name=ad, which is the label carried by the ad Deployment's pod template, so the missing piece is a running pod/endpoint, not a label mismatch.

No Evicted or OOMKilled evidence exists for the removed ad pod: its deletion is recorded as a Normal 'Stopping container ad' pod event plus a Normal ReplicaSet SuccessfulDelete and a Deployment ScaleDown event, not a kubelet eviction or container termination.

Other services' error-span counters do not show a new deviation tied to this window: accounting, ad, fraud-detection and payment are 0 in every 5-minute sample from 02:07:00 to 02:32:00, while recommendation shows sporadic 1.33 already at 02:07:00 and 02:17:00 (before the alert) as well as at 02:27:00.

Primary hypothesis: ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory is the object that turned a single ad pod deletion into a sustained outage - its used memory (1901Mi) exceeds its hard limit (1503238553600m), so every attempt to create the 225Mi ad pod is rejected, ad stays at zero endpoints, and frontend's /api/data fails on its AdService/GetAds call for as long as the quota is exhausted.

Secondary hypothesis (mechanism detail, not verified): the frontend's error spans on grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds and tcp.connect are connection-level failures to Service ad, which has no ready addresses after the ad pod disappeared; the error detail text itself was not readable, so this remains an inference from the coincident tcp.connect errors and the empty Endpoints subset.

Secondary hypothesis: frontend-proxy's error spans on ingress and router frontend egress are responses to the failed frontend /api/data requests (same 02:24-02:26 start, matching volume), but its own error detail could not be read, so this propagation is unverified.

Recommended next steps for a human: inspect audit/GitOps change history for who set Deployment ad replicas to 0 at 02:24:01 and back to 1 at 02:24:11; reconcile the otel-demo-memory ResourceQuota with the sum of the namespace's pod memory requests (or lower requests) so that the 225Mi ad pod can be scheduled; then confirm ad-554b849958 has a Running/ready pod and that Endpoints/ad regains an address.

gaps: The actor/change that scaled Deployment ad from 1 to 0 at 02:24:01 and back to 1 at 02:24:11 is unknown: change_history is not an available integration, and no event names a caller other than the deployment controller's own ScaleDown/ScaleUp events.

Application logs could not be used: fetch_pod_logs returned 0 bytes / 0 lines for frontend-675fd7b5c5-nkn95 (02:00-02:40) and for flagd-7b4bf67b7f-xbq4d containers, and pod ad-554b849958-p226w no longer exists, so its logs and previous-container logs are unavailable.

Span-level error detail for the failing period is unavailable: this Jaeger's newest trace in the target is 02:23:19 (healthy), the frontend trace search over 01:25-02:40 was RESULT_TOO_LARGE with data only up to 02:23:19, so the exact error message on GET /api/data and grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds error spans after 02:24 cannot be read.

kube-state-metrics series such as kube_deployment_status_replicas_available/ready and kube_pod_* returned no data for this window, so the deployment/pod replica history could not be charted; the deployment conclusions rest on current object state plus events.

The timing and cause of the quota over-commit (used 1901Mi vs hard 1503238553600m) are unknown - no history of the ResourceQuota or of other workloads' requests is available, so which pod's requests pushed usage above the limit is unresolved.
A networkpolicies query in otel-demo returned no objects (status no_data, not citable), so the absence of NetworkPolicies is unchecked rather than proven.

A chaos/litmus/fault CRD search and a jobs listing both returned no data (status no_data), so the presence of such controllers or of the Job objects referenced in data-recorders events could not be verified.

The alerting rule definition was taken from the Prometheus rule-file ConfigMap because list_prometheus_rules returned no data for RequestErrorRate, so the rule's live state at alert time is unverified.
next_steps: Check cluster audit logs or GitOps/CI history for the scale operation on Deployment ad at 02:24:01 and the reverse at 02:24:11.

Reconcile ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory (hard 1503238553600m, used 1901Mi) with the actual sum of container memory requests in otel-demo, then verify ad-554b849958 schedules a pod and Endpoints/ad gets an address.
Once a pod exists, re-check ad service spans and frontend error spans to confirm the /api/data error rate returns to its pre-02:24 zero baseline.
Add capacity/availability alerting on Deployment ad (available replicas = 0) so a missing dependency pod is caught before only its callers' error rate fires.

groups:
- interval: 1m
  name: ClusterAlerts
  rules:
  - alert: FailedPodsDetected
    annotations:
      description: 'Pods in failed state in namespace {{ $labels.namespace }} is above
        0 (current: {{ $value }})'
    expr: sum by(namespace) (kube_pod_status_phase{namespace="otel-demo", phase="Failed"})
      > 0
    labels:
      severity: critical
  - alert: PendingPodsDetected
    annotations:
      description: 'Pods in pending state in namespace {{ $labels.namespace }} above
        0 (current: {{ $value }})'
    expr: sum by(namespace) (kube_pod_status_phase{namespace="otel-demo", phase="Pending"})
      > 0
    labels:
      severity: critical
  - alert: CrashLoopBackOffPodsDetected
    annotations:
      description: 'Pods in CrashLoopBackOff state in namespace {{ $labels.namespace
        }} above 0 (current: {{ $value }})'
    expr: sum by (namespace) (kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason{namespace="otel-demo",reason="CrashLoopBackOff"})
      > 0
    labels:
      severity: critical
- interval: 1m
  name: GoldenSignalAlerts
  rules:
  - alert: RequestLatency
    annotations:
      description: 'Latency in service {{ $labels.service_name }} in namespace {{
        $labels.namespace }} is above 1500ms (current: {{ $value }}s)'
    expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by(le, service_name, namespace) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{service_name!~"flagd|load-generator|accounting|fraud-detection"}[2m])))
      > 1500
    for: 1m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: RequestLatencyProcessor
    annotations:
      description: 'Latency in service {{ $labels.service_name }} in namespace {{
        $labels.namespace }} is above 15000ms (current: {{ $value }}s)'
    expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by(le, service_name, namespace) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{service_name=~"accounting|fraud-detection"}[2m])))
      > 15000
    for: 1m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: RequestErrorRate
    annotations:
      description: 'Request error rate in service {{ $labels.service_name }} in namespace
        {{ $labels.namespace }} is above 0 (current: {{ $value }})'
    expr: sum by (service_name, namespace) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR",
      service_name!~"flagd|load-generator"}[2m])) > 0
    for: 1m
    labels:
      severity: warning
- interval: 1m
  name: GoodputAlerts
  rules:
  - alert: NoRequestsDetected
    annotations:
      description: Service {{ $labels.service_name }} in namespace {{ $labels.namespace
        }} has 0 requests
    expr: sum by (service_name, namespace) (increase(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name!~"flagd|load-generator",
      namespace="otel-demo", status_code=~"STATUS_CODE_UNSET|STATUS_CODE_OK"}[2m]))
      == 0
    for: 5m
    labels:
      severity: warning
- interval: 1m
  name: KafkaAlerts
  rules:
  - alert: KafkaConnectionClosureRate
    annotations:
      description: 'Job {{ $labels.job }} has a closure rate above 0 (current: {{
        $value }})'
    expr: sum by (job) (kafka_consumer_connection_close_rate) > 0
    for: 1m
    labels:
      severity: warning
